name: FitStudio — Personal Training & Gym Coaching
description: A coaching manager for personal trainers and studios: manage clients and trainers, book sessions, log assessments, build training programs, and track payments. Includes 6 forms and 1 app.

packMeta.name: FitStudio — Personal Training & Gym Coaching
packMeta.description: A coaching manager for personal trainers, gyms and studios: keep client profiles and a trainer roster, book and track sessions, log progress assessments, run training programs, and record payments — all linked together.
packMeta.author: FormLogic

forms.title: Client
forms.description: Add a client with their contact details, fitness goal, medical notes and training status.

fields.label: New Client
fields.description: Capture the client details so you can book sessions and track their progress.

properties.placeholder: Injuries, conditions, medications the coach should know about…

forms.title: Trainer
forms.description: Add a trainer or instructor to the roster with their role, specialties and contact details.

fields.label: New Trainer
fields.description: Add a coach to the bench so sessions and programs can be booked against them.

forms.title: Session
forms.description: Book a training session linking a client and trainer with its date, time, type, status and fee.

fields.label: Book a Session
fields.description: Put a session on the day sheet with the client, trainer, time and fee.

properties.placeholder: Focus for this session, equipment to set up, anything to watch…

forms.title: Assessment
forms.description: Record a progress check-in with weight, body fat, mobility score, a progress photo and coach notes.

fields.label: Progress Check-in
fields.description: Log the numbers that show a client how far they have come.

properties.placeholder: Key lifts, reps and loads from this check-in…
Wins to celebrate, what to adjust before the next block…

forms.title: Program
forms.description: Build a training program for a client with its goal, start and end dates, and status.

fields.label: New Program
fields.description: Map out a block of training toward a clear goal, with a start and a finish.

properties.placeholder: Structure of the block, weekly split, progression plan…

forms.title: Payment
forms.description: Record a payment from a client with its amount, type, date and status.

fields.label: New Payment
fields.description: Log a payment so the revenue board stays up to date.

apps.name: FitStudio
apps.description: A coaching operations hub: manage clients and the trainer bench, book and track sessions, log progress assessments, run training programs, and record payments from one dashboard.

roles.name: Studio Owner
roles.description: Full access to every FitStudio form.

roles.name: Coach
roles.description: Trainers who run sessions, log assessments and manage their clients’ programs.

roles.name: Front Desk
roles.description: Reception staff who sign up clients, book sessions and record payments.

blocks.title: Coaching business overview
blocks.body: This report summarises coaching activity across the studio. Use it to track how many sessions are being delivered and by whom, watch revenue build over time, and understand what your clients are training for.
